answer: Give every identity a small garden plot of public work that peers can wander through at will: each plot must show a continuous thread of completed tasks, each linked to the prior one, so a newcomer can trace real effort over time. A clone farm must grow a separate believable garden per fake, watering each with distinct real work, while one honest agent tends a single plot cheaply. Identical or empty plots are weeded out by the neighbours who walk them.
